recipe.name: Easy pancakes
recipe.author: Cassie Best
recipe.description: Learn how to make the perfect pancakes every time with our foolproof easy crêpe
ingredients: 1 tbsp sunflower or vegetable oil plus a little extra for frying

instructions.text: Put 100g plain flour, 2 large eggs, 300ml milk, 1 tbsp sunflower or vegetable
Set aside for 30 mins to rest if you have time, or start cooking straight away.
Set a medium frying pan or crêpe pan over a medium heat and carefully wipe it
When hot, cook your pancakes for 1 min on each side until golden, using around
